reason: I take most of my work through WhatsApp and Instagram and keep all of it. A platform that takes 10% of every paid job is taking money from my own customers, and I don't want a middleman between me and the people who already know my number.
objection: Once a customer finds me through ArmorHub, they'll have my number and will book with me directly next time, so the 10% is paid once and then I'm just giving the platform a cut of my own regulars.
would_change_my_mind: If ArmorHub showed me that most of the jobs it sends are new customers I could not get on my own, and that repeat customers are blocked from bypassing the platform, I would test it on a few jobs.
